tier2.summary:
INCOMPLETE
  ✗ GET /api/memories?namespace=X&q= on a namespace with zero prior traffic must not pay a >1s cold-scan penalty vs the same query unscoped; warm-up covers all manifest namespaces; tests cover warm-up + no regression on scoped/unscoped search: All three sub-claims are unmet. (a) The ?q= path is recallTool (src/mcp/tools/recall.ts:868) -> keywordSearch (src/search/query.ts:370) -> ensureFreshIndex (src/search/query.ts:382) -> runEnsureFreshIndex (src/search/index.ts:551) -> rebuildNamespaceIndex (src/search/index.ts:280), which does a full JSON.parse of every .jsonl (collectLiveMemoryRows), stages rows.tmp.jsonl, INSTALL/LOAD fts, CREATE TABLE, INSERT read_json, PRAGMA create_fts_index, rename. Live namespaces/default/.search/meta.json records durationMs=933 for 3272 rows/20 files, and that namespace is currently STALE (newest jsonl mtime 2026-10-13T09:05:23Z > indexedAt 2026-09-28T17:05:35Z), so the first scoped ?q= pays it. warmNamespace (src/http/namespace-warmup.ts:95-125) only does getDuckDBConnection("singleton", nsPath) + queryMemories(db, partitionPaths, {limit:1}) — the LIST path. It never calls ensureFreshIndex/keywordSearch, never touches EmbeddingCache.forNamespace(nsPath) (<ns>/.embeddings, src/embedding/cache.ts:63-68), and never pre-embeds candidates (semanticSearch on-the-fly embeds up to 50 uncached texts, src/embedding/search.ts:122,168-171). The dominant cold cost of the scoped ?q= request is untouched. (b) warmManifestNamespaces (src/http/namespace-warmup.ts:158-161) enumerates censusOnDiskNamespaces(resolveNamespacesPath()) = every directory under namespaces/ (live root: 806 dirs), not "manifest namespaces" (listNamespaces, src/search/index.ts:626-637, requires manifest.json; live root: 794), and runs strictly sequentially, so on the live 806-namespace root a namespace late in readdir order is still cold when a request arrives. (c) src/http/namespace-warmup-aug096.test.ts has 8 tests, all green (`npx vitest run src/http/namespace-warmup-aug096.test.ts` -> 1 file passed, 8 tests passed, exit 0), but they only cover warm-up mechanics (connections per census ns, limit-1 scan forced, failure tolerance + eviction, env guard, corrupted manifest, enumeration failure, log line). No test issues GET /api/memories?namespace=X&q=, none measures scoped-vs-unscoped latency or the >1s penalty, none asserts "no regression on scoped/unscoped search", and none asserts warm-up covers manifest namespaces (it asserts census.size). No test in src/cli/http.test.ts references startNamespaceWarmup wiring. Regression runs are green (src/http 54 files/388 tests; src/cli/http.test.ts 8 tests; src/search 8 files/87 tests; src/duckdb 12 files/124 tests; src/mcp/tools 18 files/148 tests; src/http/routes/memories-dogfood001.test.ts 3 tests, all exit 0), so there is no regression — but the criterion's specific demands are not met.
The warm-up only pre-creates the singleton DuckDB connection and runs a limit-1 list query, leaving the ?q= path's dominant cold costs (FTS sidecar rebuild via ensureFreshIndex, per-namespace embedding cache, on-the-fly candidate embeds) unwarmed, and no test covers scoped-vs-unscoped latency or no-regression on scoped/unscoped search.
